Name: Stardew News Feed
Author: NorthMS
Description:
This mod checks various locations for harvestable items every morning, and provides notifications for where items were found.

[size=5]Currently Supported Notifications[/size]
[list=1]
[*]Farm Cave has Mushrooms/Fruit
[*]Greenhouse has harvestable items
[*]Cellar has harvestable items
[*]Sheds have harvestable items
[*]Barn Animals have produce available
[*]Barn Auto-Grabber has items
[*]Coops have animal products available
[*]Silo's are below 15% Capacity
[*]Someone nearby has a birthday today
[/list]

[size=5]Configuration
[/size]
Scanning of all locations can be toggled via a config file (config.json) located in the installation directory.
Note: This config file is created the first time the mod is loaded into the game, so it will not be preset immediately after installation. You must load a saved game (or start a new game) and begin your first day before this config file gets created with the default values.

[size=5]Language Support[/size]
[*] English
[*] Spanish
[*] German
[*]Portugese
[*]French
[*]Korean
[*] more coming soon

[size=5]Upcoming Features/Fixes[/size]
[url=https://github.com/Mikesnorth/StardewNewsFeed/issues]Issue Tracker[/url]

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.3.* on Linux/Mac/Windows.
[*]Works in single player and multiplayer.
[/list]

[size=5]See also[/size]

[list]
[*][url=https://github.com/OtherBuckets/StardewNewsFeed]Source code and Documentation[/url]
[/list]
